# React Bits Stepper design attribution

Official preview: https://reactbits.dev/components/stepper
Official source: https://github.com/DavidHDev/react-bits/tree/main/src/content/Components/Stepper
Official license: https://github.com/DavidHDev/react-bits/blob/main/LICENSE.md
Retrieved and checked: 2026-10-12.

The desktop-only UI adapts the Stepper's dark framed surface, numbered stage
segments, gliding active indicator, and focused content panel. It is ported
into the application's existing TypeScript/DOM renderer; it does not install
React Bits, React, Motion, or an icon dependency and is not MCP-generated.

MIT + Commons Clause copyright and permission text is preserved in LICENSE.md.
This code is used as part of the private academy application, not offered as
standalone or bundled components. Original completion ticks and the final
completion action are intentionally not used: local navigation never establishes
learning completion. No completion percentage or per-stage progress is inferred.
